summary: Tested the bus data integration: Avanza live feed for Estación Sur and the Alsa GTFS schedule for Av. América. Tested at 22:28 CET on Sun 1 Nov 2026. Backend: GET /api/buses returns avenida_america with source=alsa_gtfs, the correct label, 10 arrivals, all ALSA/Programado and all long-distance (the 91 GTFS trips come from 15 origins, none of them Alcalá, Guadalajara or Torrejón). It returns estacion_sur with source=avanza_live, the correct label, 33 arrivals from real companies (ALSA, MONBUS, AVANZA, FLIXBUS, AISA, BBC BUS, BUSBAM, SOCIBUS, INTERB...), statuses limited to En dársena/Retrasado/Programado, and a dársena number on every 'En dársena' row. Scores and winner flags are consistent, with exactly one winner per window. 27/27 pytest passed (new test_buses_api.py with 3 tests, test_bus_sources.py with 2, plus test_adif_siv.py and test_flight_classifier.py). Frontend at 390px: admin login, then Autobuses tab. bus-source-avenida_america shows the Alsa label with a grey dot; bus-source-estacion_sur shows the live label with a green dot (#10B981). Status badges are green for En dársena, red for Retrasado and indigo for Programado. Rows show ' · Dársena N'. Trenes and Aviones tabs still render, and the public PublicBusArrivals widget on the login screen shows both stations.

minor.issue: filter_upcoming only shows arrivals from now-5min onward, using the scheduled time. A RETRASADO bus whose scheduled time is more than 5 min ago (it has not arrived yet) disappears from the list. filter_and_count_arrivals also counts it as 'past' rather than upcoming. Suggest keeping Retrasado rows visible and counting them as upcoming until they become SITUADO or leave the feed.

Some Avanza origins read oddly after _title(): 'Manga, La' and 'Oliva, Playa' come from the source's inverted article format, and 'Santiago Composte' is truncated by the source. Cosmetic: could normalise 'X, La' to 'La X'.

filter_and_count_arrivals and filter_upcoming rebuild datetimes from 'time' (HH:MM) even though every new item already has an ISO 'at'. This works now but is fragile around midnight and DST; prefer 'at' when it is present.

issues: Because originText uses numberOfLines=1, the ' · Dársena N' suffix is cut off next to the status badge (e.g. 'Granada · Dárs…'), so the most useful new information is hidden on phones. Show the dársena on its own line or as a small badge.
bus_company column is fixed at width 55. Longer names such as 'ALS GPY', 'BBC BUS' or 'FLIXBUS' are tight there and may wrap. No testIDs in this component.
Footer still says 'Datos basados en horarios de ADIF y AENA'; it could mention Avanza/Alsa on the bus tab.

action_items: Optional: on mobile, show the dársena separately from the truncated origin text
Optional: keep Retrasado Estación Sur arrivals visible and counted as upcoming after their scheduled time passes
Optional: use the ISO 'at' field for windowing/counting
critical_code_review_comments: bus_sources.py is clean. The GTFS reduction filters correctly by distance (>=70 km), drop_off_type and first stop, and handles after-midnight times (offset) and calendar exceptions.
ensure_alsa_schedule writes the JSON with blocking Path.write_text inside async code. The file is small, so this is acceptable.
avamerica_arrivals checks service days -2..+1. That is fine, but -2 is only needed for trips with offset >= 2, which the 8h window makes unlikely.

routers/buses.py: if the GTFS schedule returns no arrivals in the window (e.g. late night), Av. América falls back to the CheckMyBus scraper and then to static schedules. The static fallback includes Guadalajara/Alcalá, which contradicts the long-distance-only intent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: click 'Soy taxista', fill placeholders 'Nombre de usuario'/'Contraseña' (admin/admin), then click data-testid=login-button. Bus tab: click text 'Calle' (the dropdown), then 'Autobuses'. testIDs: bus-source-<station>, bus-status-<station>-<i>. The public widget 'Estaciones de autobuses' appears on the login screen after clicking 'Soy taxista'. test_buses_api.py hits the live endpoint; the AA test skips if the GTFS window is empty.
